lede: Tuesday's tech relief rally unravelled as Nvidia fell almost 6% and chip stocks slid, pulling the S&P 500 lower and sending Korean and Japanese shares sharply down this morning. Gold lost over 2% to about $3,550 even as the dollar eased, with a December Fed hike almost fully priced ahead of today's PCE and GDP data.

focus.text: Gold dropped 2.2% to ~$3,552 on tech-led liquidation and Fed-hike bets, trading below its 3,592.5 pivot. Main risk: US core PCE and Q3 GDP at 16:30 TRT.
Euro bounced 0.6% to ~1.0966 from Monday's 2026 low of 1.0884 as the dollar eased and ECB-hike talk firmed. US PCE/GDP at 16:30 TRT is today's test.

technicals.note: Monday's rebound failed near 3,680 and price fell back to the lower end of the recent range, keeping the sequence of lower highs intact.

calendar.event: Australia October CPI (out: 4.9% y/y, trimmed mean 3.8%)

news.text: Nvidia gave back almost 6% and the chip index sank 7.9%; S&P 500 fell 0.5%, Nasdaq 1.5%, while the Dow rose 0.85%.
AI doubts spilled into Asia: the Kospi slid nearly 6% with Samsung and SK Hynix down over 8%, and the Nikkei lost more than 3%.
Gold fell 2.2% to about $3,552 despite a softer dollar, hit by liquidation and hike bets; BCA Research closed its four-year bullish gold call.
Futures price roughly 95–97% odds of a 25bp Fed hike on 9 Dec; US consumer confidence jumped to 103.3 versus 92.5 expected.
Brent touched a three-month low of $88.10, then settled 2.3% higher at $91.40 after more ship attacks around the Strait of Hormuz.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost about $570m on Monday, a fifth straight outflow day, pushing November's total to a record ~$4.7bn.
About $844m of positions were liquidated in 24 hours as Bitcoin slipped back under $60,000; fear & greed index sits at 9.
Hyperliquid's HYPE fell about 7%, Monad hit a record low after a large token unlock, while Monero edged up around 4%.
South Korea's FSC unveiled a crypto bill that would end the ICO ban and allow bank-led won stablecoins.
CFTC staff will let regulated derivatives venues count BTC and ETH toward capital requirements with a 20% haircut.
Strategy added 457 BTC for about $29.6m, lifting its holdings to 851,305 BTC.

upcoming.event: US Thanksgiving; Bank of Korea rate decision
upcoming.note: US markets shut; BoK expected to hike to 3.25%.
Markets see high odds of a BoJ hike on 18 Dec.
Set to decide 2027 quotas and baselines.
